name: SQL database in Microsoft Fabric
sku: SQL database in Microsoft Fabric, which uses the same SQL Database Engine as Azure SQL Database, on a Fabric capacity.

source.oltp.note: The home in Fabric for OLTP workloads. Its data is replicated into OneLake in near real time so it can be analysed without loading the transactional database.

bands.note: Row-level and object-level security, sharing of a single database without workspace access, and Microsoft Entra authentication.

proposed_capabilities.name: Vector search for retrieval
proposed_capabilities.description: Vector data types and search inside the transactional database, with integration into frameworks such as LangChain and Semantic Kernel, so retrieval-augmented generation reads live operational data.

presentation.tagline: Transactional SQL database inside Fabric, mirrored to OneLake.
